claim: PUT and DELETE /recurring-orders/:restaurantId/:id (RecurringOrdersController.update and .deactivate) call OrganizationsService.assertCanManageRestaurant(user.userId, restaurantId, action) before the service call, so a caller whose role at the house is not owner or manager, or cannot be read, gets 403 and nothing is written (ADR 0246, founder ruling 2026-10-01: "Managers and owners only (Recommended)"). POST create carries no such check: staff may still create a schedule. At e88593bf8 both routes carried only the class JwtAuthGuard, and a staff edit to a manager's schedule was raised by the 08:00 cron under the manager's created_by (Audit of PR #538 at 46c74b08f, finding 1). Pinned by recurring-schedule-edits-need-a-manager.http.spec.ts (5 [REVERT-FAILS] cases red on e88593bf8; 5 pins).
